What each option includes

  • Collaborative treatment planning grounded in evidence-informed practice.
  • Flexible session frequency — we’ll adjust as goals shift.
  • Care notes, resources, and modest between-session messaging when clinically appropriate.

Modalities: {{MODALITIES}}. I aim to create an accessible, respectful space focused on your values and strengths.

How payment works

Payment is due at the time of service. I accept card and bank transfer. Sliding scale limited; please inquire if cost is a barrier.

Boundaries & scope

Therapy is a professional relationship. I do not provide emergency services. If you are in crisis or at risk, please call emergency services or your local crisis line immediately.

Questions I often hear

How do I know if therapy is the right step now?
Many people come when they notice patterns that feel stuck — increased anxiety, relationship tension, life transitions, or burnout. We can start with a single session to explore fit and goals without committing to a long plan.
What do sessions typically focus on?
Sessions are collaborative. We build from your concerns and values, blending practical tools with deeper exploration. Modalities I use include {{MODALITIES}}. Each plan is personalized to your needs.
Can I use insurance?
I do not bill insurance directly. I can provide a superbill for clients who wish to seek reimbursement. Insurance coverage, limits, and copays vary — please check with your provider.
Is telehealth available?
Yes. I offer secure video sessions and in-person options when available. We'll discuss what best supports your privacy and accessibility needs.
How long does therapy usually last?
There is no one-size-fits-all timeline. Some people seek brief support for a season; others prefer ongoing weekly work. We set collaborative goals and review progress regularly.

Free guide: Preparing for your first session

A short checklist to help you make the most of your first appointment — what to expect, helpful questions, and how to prepare emotionally.

Get the Guide

I respect your privacy. Your contact details will be used only to deliver the guide and clinic communications.

Need immediate help?
If you are at risk of harm or in crisis, call emergency services or your local crisis line. Therapy is not an emergency service.

Privacy & limits of therapy

Your communications with me are confidential with limited exceptions (risk of harm, court order, or mandated reporting). You can request a copy of the privacy practices during intake.
